result.line: Pure custody: 1 EOA + 3 Gnosis Safes (v1.3.0/v1.4.1, 3-of-5) hold 32.90 BTC of WBTC/LBTC/cbBTC (~.91M vs TVL .74M); no caller-paid function, execTransaction reverts GS020 from a fresh address and pays nothing (gasPrice=gasToken=refundReceiver=0); 7d (blocks 26411711-26462003): 1 execTransaction (0x0d63c905, non-owner submitter 0xe1bb4b59 ate bash.054 gas, bash refund) + 30 cbBTC deposits (6.82 cbBTC ~97k) all from one operator EOA; stranger paid: bash.
